title: Derived tensor product of perfect objects is perfect
statement: Let (X,\mathcal O_X) be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let K,L be perfect objects [def-pc-perfect-complex] of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Then the derived tensor product K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L is a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X).

proof.text: By [def-pc-perfect-complex] there are open coverings $X=\bigcup_iU_i$ and $X=\bigcup_jV_j$ with $K|_{U_i}$ and $L|_{V_j}$ isomorphic in the derived categories to strictly perfect complexes. Restriction to an open is an exact functor on modules and the restriction of a strictly perfect complex to a smaller open is strictly perfect (restrict the finite free modules and the summand decompositions), so on each $W=U_i\cap V_j$ of the covering $X=\bigcup_{i,j}W$ there are strictly perfect complexes $\mathcal E^\bullet,\mathcal F^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_W$-modules with $K|_W\cong\mathcal E^\bullet$ and $L|_W\cong\mathcal F^\bullet$ in $D(\mathcal O_W)$. By [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde] (1), applied to $f=\mathrm{id}_X$ and the open $W$, $(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)|_W\cong K|_W\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_W}L|_W\cong\mathcal E^\bullet\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_W}\mathcal F^\bullet$.

source.place: Lemma lemma-tensor-perfect (Tag 09J5), local reduction to strictly perfect models

proof.text: Each term $\mathcal E^i$ is a direct summand of a finite free $\mathcal O_W$-module $\mathcal O_W^{\oplus r}$, hence flat (a direct summand of a flat module is flat), and $\mathcal E^\bullet$ is bounded, in particular bounded above. Hence $\mathcal E^\bullet$ is K-flat by [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat], so the identity is a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex] and, with the description of $\otimes^{\mathbf L}$ in [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde], $\mathcal E^\bullet\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_W}\mathcal F^\bullet$ is represented by the total tensor complex $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal E^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_W}\mathcal F^\bullet)$.

source.place: Lemma lemma-tensor-perfect (Tag 09J5), K-flat strictly perfect models

proof.text: Since $\mathcal E^\bullet$ and $\mathcal F^\bullet$ are bounded, $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal E^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O_W}\mathcal F^\bullet)$ is bounded, and its degree-$n$ term is the finite direct sum $\bigoplus_{i+j=n}\mathcal E^i\otimes_{\mathcal O_W}\mathcal F^j$. If $\mathcal E^i\oplus\mathcal E'\cong\mathcal O_W^{\oplus r}$ and $\mathcal F^j\oplus\mathcal F'\cong\mathcal O_W^{\oplus s}$, then $\mathcal E^i\otimes\mathcal F^j$ is a direct summand of $\mathcal O_W^{\oplus r}\otimes\mathcal O_W^{\oplus s}\cong\mathcal O_W^{\oplus rs}$, and a finite direct sum of direct summands of finite free modules is again one. So the total complex is strictly perfect, $(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)|_W$ is isomorphic to a strictly perfect complex for every member $W$ of the covering, and $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L$ is perfect by [def-pc-perfect-complex].
